notes.on-this-day: Fires only on a real dated anniversary; run it by hand on a date you know matches.
notes.one-line: A verbatim line of dialogue from the film's own subtitle track (~14% of the catalog publishes one). Always from the first 60% — a line from the last reel can give away an ending.
